heads.la: § 1. Sancti Sigeberti uxor Imnechildis, filius Dagobertus rex Austrasiorum; neptis sancta Irmina, abnepos sanctus Gregorius Ultrajectinus, aliique a sancto Sigeberto, prognati.
heads.en: § 1. The wife of Saint Sigebert, Imnechildis; his son Dagobert, king of the Austrasians; his granddaughter Saint Irmina, his great-great-grandson Saint Gregory of Utrecht, and others descended from Saint Sigebert.

headnotes.la: … Childericum regem, etiam postquam hic Bilichildem uxorem duxerat. Donationes monachis Stabulens. et Malmundariens. a sancto Sigeberto factas hi tres confirmant. Ipsum diploma infra dandum sic incipit
headnotes.en: … Childeric, even after he had taken Bilichild to wife. These three confirm the donations made by Saint Sigebert to the monks of Stavelot and Malmedy. The diploma itself, to be given below, begins thus
And this is its closing clause

headnotes.la: …um Austrasiorum retinuit; in quo Imnechildem reginam aliqua adhuc cum potestate vixisse innuitur in Vita sancti Praejecti episcopi Arvernorum, 25 Jan., ex Ms. Ultraject. edita, ubi, n. 11, ita legitur
headnotes.en: …ldis was still living with some measure of power is intimated in the Life of Saint Praejectus, bishop of the Arverni, 25 January, published from a Utrecht manuscript, where, at number 11, we read thus

headnotes.la: …ria a sancto Sigeberto exstructa, mox dicemus eminere Stabulaum et Malmundarium: quibus donationem a patre suo factam confirmavit Dagobertus jam rex apud Austras. constitutus. Quod diploma ita incipit
headnotes.en: …gebert, we shall shortly say that Stavelot and Malmedy stand out: to which Dagobert, now established as king among the Austrasians, confirmed the donation made by his father. Which diploma begins thus

headnotes.la: …buit Gelenius; universim viginti exstructa cum Gelenio volunt Molan., in Auctario Usuardi, Galesin. et Sauss., quorum verba supra dedimus. Brouwerus de iis, in sua Metropoli, necdum edita, ita scribit
headnotes.en: …n all, with Gelenius, Molanus, in the *Auctarium* to Usuard, Galesinius, and Saussay would have it — whose words we have given above. Brouwer writes thus of them in his *Metropolis*, not yet published

headnotes.la: …scopus Leodiensis, in Vita sancti Remachi episcopi Trajectensis, 3 Sept., meminit alterius Vitae ab auctore antiquiore et fere coaevo conscriptae, de quo in prologo ad Werenfridum abbatem haec scribit
headnotes.en: …Saint Remaclus, bishop of Maastricht, 3 September, makes mention of another Life composed by an older and almost contemporary author, concerning which he writes thus in the prologue to Abbot Werenfrid

headnotes.la: In hoc priori libello, seu Vita sancti Remacli, de exstructis monasteriis Stabulensi et Malmundariensi ita legitur
headnotes.en: In this earlier little book, or Life of Saint Remaclus, we read thus concerning the building of the monasteries of Stavelot and Malmedy
